owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.title: One store, one state machine, one coordinator, reached from the daemon
requirements: SO-1.01 requirement 1: "Make the project store the durable authority for project entities and append-only events." (source: contract SO-1.01 T1)

SO-1.01 requirement 2: "Make the state machine and coordinator responsible for task lifecycle, claims, leases, generations, dependency-aware dispatch, resource selection, ownership, retries, recovery and execution scheduling." (source: contract SO-1.01 T1)

SO-1.01 requirement 3: "Route state changes through the existing transition rules; adapters and UI code must not mutate authoritative state directly." (source: contract SO-1.01 T1; tests test/project-wiring.test.mjs:27, :35, :56, :115 and :137)

The project and task operations are typed tools on the existing MCP handler, the same over stdio and HTTP and scoped by the caller token and seat: memev_task_plan, memev_task_claim, memev_task_heartbeat, memev_task_report, memev_task_release, memev_task_verify and memev_project_status (source: signed vault contract SO-05-A, cited by id only; this pull request is its build evidence, src/server/mcp.mjs)

Nothing but the project store constructs the store or the coordinator, and project modules persist only through the store (source: signed vault contract SO-06-A, cited by id only; the single-construction test in test/project-wiring.test.mjs)

MV-ARCH-09: No competing state stores, duplicate coordinators or separate policy engines are created while the architecture grows. (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:18; baseline 8.5)
tasks.description: The vault holds one store and one coordinator per project; the MCP task tools move a task through the transition table; an agent report moves a task to VERIFYING and never to a finished state. The single-authority guard (WP07-04) is carried by MV-ARCH-09 and test/project-wiring.test.mjs in this task, not by SO-1.01. The project store takes and releases its lock whole (commits 801c7ca and f48a8e1, a stale lock is taken over without failing when its holder releases it meanwhile), so two processes cannot both hold it.

tasks.title: The rest of the project state machine is wired, and a contract verify feeds a task verify (done in pull request #326, commit fc6df28)
requirements: SO-1.01 requirement 2: "Make the state machine and coordinator responsible for task lifecycle, claims, leases, generations, dependency-aware dispatch, resource selection, ownership, retries, recovery and execution scheduling."; SO-1.01 requirement 3: "Route state changes through the existing transition rules; adapters and UI code must not mutate authoritative state directly." (source: contract SO-1.01 T1)

The state machine owns lifecycle changes, so amendScope, applyUpdate, reassign, eligibleForDispatch, pause, requestCancellation, resume and EventLog (exported by src/engine/project-state.mjs) must each be reached from the coordinator, the vault or an MCP route in src/server/mcp.mjs, and must not only be defined; each must be called from at least one module other than src/engine/project-state.mjs, and test/project-wiring-remaining.test.mjs must prove each call path (source: src/engine/project-state.mjs exports; before pull request #326 none of them was called outside project-state.mjs, and the criteria below hold the requirement open on any later change)

memev_task_verify accepts only evidence from a passing memev_contract_verify receipt for a task that is tied to a contract: the verify feed runs through the memev_contract_verify route in src/server/mcp.mjs and the evidence is bound to the task scope version and artifact hash. A task planned without a contract may be verified by the operator by hand with local evidence for every mandatory criterion (source: contracts SR-1.27 and SR-1.30; test/task-verify-from-contract.test.mjs:40, :67 and :96; the memev_task_verify tool description in src/server/mcp.mjs; satisfied in commit fc6df28)

request: Per-pull-request contract for memev, branch feat/wire-project-engine (pull request #326, head fc6df28, checks green; it implements SO-1.01 and closes this contract's T1 to T4). Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs after the red-team gate. Repository: memev. It implements the decisions of contract SO-1.01 (canonical execution integration, signed 31 Oct 2026, design-record stage) and does not restate them: SO-1.01 asks for the decision record, this contract asks for the code that follows it. Programme tasks covered: WP07-01 to WP07-04 and WP15-01. SO-1.01 stays the source of truth and this spec does not replace it: it keeps only the build and test criteria that the design record does not hold (the wiring, the single-authority guard and the adversarial tests). Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply (the engine decision confirmed by the owner, t542u): crdt-merge stays in its own repository (BSL 1.1 with its PATENTS file) and is reached only across the call-out boundary, never vendored, so inclusion cannot relicense it; tiers are the free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that, with no Federated tier and no separate Personal trial; federation is planned, not available. WBS section 9.1 records this as the same work as SO-1.01 (the record and its build); the owner confirms one is not signed twice. The SO-1.01 design record (docs/scope-one/design/canonical-execution-integration.md) is that contract's deliverable, owned by that contract, and is referenced here, not written or edited. T4 records the wiring that pull request #326 added last (commit fc6df28): the rest of the project state machine and the task-verify feed. Depends on contracts: SO-1.01, SO-04-A, SO-05-A, SO-06-A, SO-07-A, SO-08-A, SR-1.27, SR-1.30. Signed vault contract SO-05-A (cited by id only): typed project and task tools on the MCP handler (this pull request is the build of that contract: memev_task_plan, _claim, _heartbeat, _report, _release, _verify and memev_project_status). Signed vault contract SO-06-A (cited by id only): the single-construction guard (T1) and the rule that no project module imports the merge engine (T3).
